'''Sandra Grau Muxella'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Grau|Muxella}} (born 27 April 1970) is an [[Andorra|Andorran]] [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. She competed in [[Alpine skiing at the 1988 Winter Olympics|three events]] at the [[1988 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/gr/sandra-grau-1.html |title=Sandra Grau |access-date=24 March 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203064947/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/gr/sandra-grau-1.html |archive-date=3 December 2016 |quote=Full name: Sandra Grau Muxella}}</ref>

She is the sister of alpine skier [[Vicky Grau]].<ref name="SportsRef" />
